comment: The national digital architect is positioned as an individual or small team with authority across programmes and ministries. In many countries, such authority cannot be exercised by a technical role without a formal legal or governance mandate.

anchor.note: p.93-94 l.Lines 226-236 read as the printed page; section 4.2.4 agrees

public.text: The national digital architect is positioned as an individual or small team with authority across programmes and ministries. In many countries, such authority cannot be exercised by a technical role without a formal legal or governance mandate.
public.suggestedRevision: Define the role as an accountable architecture function established through the national governance structure, with delegated authority, escalation routes, and support from procurement, finance, legal, security, and sector leadership.
